annotations.title: Recorded crime of a French commune

description: Offences recorded by police and gendarmerie (SSMSI, latest year) for a French commune — by name, INSEE code or position — per indicator, as rates per 1,000 inhabitants (per 1,000 dwellings for burglaries), next to its département, région and France, with the yearly trend.

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

commune.description: Commune name or INSEE code (e.g. "Carnac", "56034"), or a département code ("56").

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

name: crime_stats
title: Recorded crime of a French commune
